comment: Development-toolchain advisories the release check may pass while they stand. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails the check. Production (npm audit --omit=dev) has no exceptions.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists (<=3.0.3 is every version). Since Tailwind 4 (5.3.0) it reaches the toolchain only through eslint-config-next (@next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch), which expands this repository's own lint patterns, never request input. Remove when braces publishes a fix or eslint-config-next drops fast-glob.
